items.prompt: The stream is ten zeros followed by 1. Under this public rule, which statistics classify the 1?

options.text: Moments of all 11 values, including the new 1.
options.why: The task explicitly ingests the current value before classifying it with population moments.

options.text: Moments of only the ten earlier zeros.
options.why: That is a prior-baseline policy, not the declared self-inclusive rule.

options.text: Only the value 1, discarding the earlier observations.
options.why: All ingested values remain in this cumulative population statistic.
This is not a width 3 rolling-window detector; the full prefix is used.
